tasks.title: 接口业务实现 · 读取服务器时间：应用服务与响应对象
tasks.description:
1. Spring @Service 应用服务，作为本模块（模块根 com.cmbchina.backend.servertime）唯一应用服务，后续端点在此追加方法。
字段：无注入依赖（本端点来源为 static，不涉及 Repository 或外部 Client）。
方法：ServerTimeResponse readServerTime()，对应端点 server_time_contract.read_server_time。
处理逻辑：按确认的 fieldMappings 组装响应对象，字段 currentTime 为 processingType=direct、mappingType=source_mapping、sourceType=static 的直接映射；取 sourceBinding=static 对应的静态字段 currentTime 值赋给 ServerTimeResponse.currentTime，按 missingBehavior=error 处理来源值缺失。
边界约束：不查询数据库、不写入数据库（databaseWrites 为空）、不调用外部接口；不引入额外业务校验或默认值。
契约缺口（需澄清，不自行实现）：staticData.currentTime 当前为空字符串，与端点描述“返回后端服务器当前时间”不一致；契约未约定时间格式与时区，因此本文件不在计划中规定时间格式化逻辑。（backend/src/main/java/com/cmbchina/backend/servertime/application/service/ServerTimeApplicationService.java）
2. 端点 server_time_contract.read_server_time 的响应 DTO（response_schema_ref=ServerTimeResponse）。
字段：currentTime，String，required=true（响应体必出现且非空），对应 response_body 路径 currentTime；该字段描述为后端服务器返回的当前时间，用于页面展示并确认前后端连通性。
约束：仅作数据承载，不含处理逻辑；不添加契约未声明的字段、时间格式注解或默认值。（backend/src/main/java/com/cmbchina/backend/servertime/application/dto/ServerTimeResponse.java）

tasks.description:

路由：@GetMapping("/api/server-time")，有效完整路径 GET /api/server-time；无请求参数（parameters 为空）、无请求体。
响应：返回 BeeResponseEntity<ServerTimeResponse>，复用 com.cmb.bee.web.entity.BeeResponseEntity 统一包装结构，data 为响应 DTO ServerTimeResponse。

build_results.agent_note: Implemented the home page at frontend/src/pages/Home/index.tsx (modify only, single file within allowed_paths). The page imports the existing business API function readServerTime from @/apis/serverTimeContractApi (endpoint server_time_contract.read_server_time, GET /api/server-time) and invokes it through ahooks useRequest on initial load, so no fetch/axios/service call exists in the page. The response field currentTime is the only data rendered: it is formatted into a readable YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss display alongside the raw backend value for verification, with a graceful fallback to the raw string when the value cannot be parsed locally (no client-side time is ever fabricated). States covered: loading (antd Skeleton before first data), error (antd Result with the service error message, e.g. INTERNAL_ERROR, plus a retry button), empty (antd Empty when no time is available) and a manual refresh action. Layout uses ProComponents as required: PageContainer as the page shell and ProCard as the content card (no bare antd Card); Pro imports come from @ant-design/pro-components and base components from antd. No permission wrappers, route/menu registration, navigation, or shared-file edits were added; src/apis/service.ts, typings, hooks, constants and layout/route files were left untouched, and no dependency install/build/lint/typecheck commands were run per the verification boundary.
